instruction: Create app/zones/[zoneId]/page.tsx in jong-jaroen (c:/Users/PC/Desktop/jong-jaroen). Zone detail page: header with zone name and type, sections: Active Sponsors (sorted by package gold>silver>bronze), Active Coupons in zone (from coupon_zones join), Recent Jobs in zone. Use sbServer(). Dark theme, no neon glow. When done trigger back to claude with [DONE] tag.
